preflight: Discard the earlier stale status snapshot and inspect the current shared workspace.
Verify the assignment contains exactly 36 unique paper IDs and matches the declared SHA-256.
Verify metadata, relevance, summary, groups, and awards are READY_FOR_REVIEW for every assigned paper before reviewing it.
Change coordination/claims/agent-h.json from PLANNED to IN_PROGRESS and list exactly the 36 assigned paper IDs.
review_requirements: Review all 36 assigned papers; do not sample.
Reopen authoritative sources independently rather than trusting stage prose or another agent's handoff.
Check metadata identity, author order, paper type, official links, and publication-time affiliations.
Challenge the relevance class, rationale, topics, system layers, contribution types, and methods.
For every summary, verify the problem, central mechanism, material assumptions, evaluation setting, baselines, study type, limitations, and claimed impact against the official full paper.
Verify every quantitative result, unit, comparison direction, experimental condition, and page, section, figure, or table locator.
Treat an unsupported generalization, incorrect mechanism, wrong baseline, wrong number, omitted material assumption, or invented limitation as an ERROR against the summary owner.
Verify every group or faculty association has suitable official evidence and is not inferred from author order; verify current and publication-time affiliations remain separate.
Verify each award or verified empty award result against the official FAST 2025 award source.
issue_and_approval_rules: Create one actionable issue per defect with the correct owner, severity, and stage.
Do not edit metadata, relevance, summary, groups, awards, entities, schemas, frontend files, or generated artifacts.
Set decision to CHANGES_REQUESTED when any open ERROR exists and route each issue to the responsible owner.
Use BLOCKED when authoritative evidence required for a decision cannot be obtained.
Set decision and workflow to APPROVED only when every applicable check is true, all stage owners are listed in independent_from, and no open ERROR remains.
After an owner reports a correction, reopen the source and verify the corrected file before resolving the issue.
handoff: Report all 36 reviewed IDs and decisions.
Report issues by severity, stage, and owner, including systematic error patterns across summaries.
Report approved, changes-requested, and blocked counts, duplicate candidates, unresolved evidence, and validator output.
Run targeted FAST 2025 and full-root draft validation.
Do not begin any expanded-corpus review without another coordinator assignment.
